title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My family i.e. my parents live in Aligarh (I an not married) I work in Noida/Delhi. Every week on Sunday evening I come to Delhi and live there at my Uncle's house (sage chachajaan). For the next five days I go to my workplace from my uncle's house. On Friday evening I go back to Aligarh. Distance between Aligarh and Delhi is about 120 Kms Every week when I come to Delhi I intend to go back to Aligarh on the comming Friday (after 5 days). And I keep minimum clothes/ belongings in Delhi - just sufficient for a week or two. Does "Qasar" applies to me? Please also guide what would be the case for my freinds who have the same routine but they live in a rented appartment in Delhi/ Noida. 2595 views Q. How to offer witr salah behind imam Kabah in Ramadan? 3058 views Q. I haven't remembered dua mathura. Can I read “Rabbijalni muqimassalati wa min zurriyati rabbana wa taqabbal dua”. 3781 views Q. Is it aloud according to the Hanafi Madhab to make duaa in English language (using translation of wordings that are mentioned in the Qur'an and Sunnah or that which is not normally possible to ask other humans for) in the last Tashahhud of salaat (fard & nafila) before the taslim? 2. Is it aloud according to the Hanafi Madhab to make duaa in English language (using translation of wordings that are mentioned in the Qur'an and Sunnah or that which is not normally possible to ask other humans for) in the Sajdah of salaat (fard & nafila) after having said three times; Subhana Rabbiyal Ala ? 3. Which dhikr or dua must one say between two sajdah's in the Hanafi Madhab? 7127 views Q. Is Namaz-e-Fajir ka waqt kab tak rehta hay awr kaysay check kray gay. I have bleeding broblem from my nose (right cavity),even in wazu if I put the water in it its bleeding, plz tell me without pouring water in my nose my wazu will be completed? 72616 views Q. Brother in Islam Kya Farmate hai Ulma-e-ikram Masla-e-zail ke bare mai: 1.Agar Azan waqt shuru hone se pehle de di gai to us Azan ko kab tak lotaya ja sakta hai ? 2.jo Azan waqt shuru hone se pehle de di gai or ab unhe(Azan ko)diye huye kafi days ya month ho gaye kya unhe bhi lotaya jayega? if yes to kese ? 3. Agar Azan nahi lotai gai to us Namaz per kya fark padega? 4.Mobile ki Ringtone mai Qur-aan ki ayat ka istemal kesa hai ? 5.Hamare Office mai Non Muslim Staff bhi kaam karta hai or wo pooja karne ke baad uska parsad sabhi ko distribute karte hai aise mai hame kaya karna chahiye ? kyu ki wahi hame work karna padta hai or wo staff hamare paas hi rehta hai ki hum us parsad ko fek nahi sakte kya kare? 4453 views Q. I study in Mumbai. Three day back I went to Gujarat (302 km away from Mumbai) for interview. I came back yesterday and I have to go to Gujarat once more for second interview after 3 days (between these two journeys I determined to stay here in Mumbai for 6 days obnly). In this case should I perform 2-4 or 4-4? I did imamat as well in these days in 4 Rakahs of Zuhr; Do my followers in the Zuhr need to perform it again? I also don?t remember which day I lead them in Zuhr. Am I Musafir while staying in Mumbai in this period? Please reply in detail. 1793 views Q. Assalam-0-Allykum, i am master stuent at KTH, stockholm, sweden. i want to ask that is it mandetory to give Azan before namaz or not? Because in paksitan there are alot of mosque and when they give Azan then we pray in mosque or in our home but here in sweden it is not the case. the mosque near to me is about 1.5 km away where i live and 2km away where the university is and it is not sure that Azan is given there or not because most of people visit mosque only on Jumma. if we want to pray in our room with Jummat then we should give Azan or not and similarly if i want to pray alone in my room or university then should i give Azan or not? some times while travelling the time of namaz come so what should i do? should i give Azan and pray on side of road or in some corner or i should pray with out Azan, or it will be better to pray in my room on return but the time of prayer will be finished. Jazakumullah Khair! 2353 views Q. Last time of zohar namaz 65711 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37257 Country: India Title: My one (two or three) rakahs left behind imam, I have done both salams with imam Question: (1) My one (two or three) rakahs left behind imam, I have done both salams with imam, then I remember, my one (two or three) rakahs is left, so I stand up and complete salah with sajdah sahv. So my salah is valid or not? Answer ID: 37257 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 477/477/M=1433) In the question mentioned above your salah was valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
